_comment: Fixture zones for bhop_badges_mini (cfg/test/p403liftrec.cfg). Copy to maps/zones/local/bhop_badges_mini.json for the run and DELETE after. The END box sits where a setpos east of the pad actually resolves -- 3056 -7376 11296.6, measured; the first cut aimed at 2700 -7096 and the engine pushed the body out of solid to there instead, so the run never finished and pm_verify held on no finish. bhop_pharma *939 was tried first and its pad sits inside a fail teleport that yanks the body to 12993 -61 -879.
